notes: Metadata is limited to what the connected database user can see.
Missing metadata does not prove an object or constraint does not exist.
Foreign-key rows with the same foreign_key_id form one composite constraint; ordinal pairs source and target columns. Search target_object_id for incoming references.
NULL definitions may be encrypted or inaccessible. T-SQL parameter defaults must also be read from module definitions.
max_length_bytes is bytes, not characters; -1 means MAX. SQL Server timestamp/rowversion is database-generated, not a date/time.
Permissions and constraint state may change after extraction; metadata does not guarantee an operation will succeed.
